caption:
Allah's mercy is close to those who do good

Allah tells us not to spread corruption on earth after it has been set right, and to call upon Him with fear and hope. His mercy is close to those who do good. Tonight, make your dua with both fear and hope.

Surah Al-A'raaf 7:56

Which good deed will you do before you sleep?

#dua #allahsmercy #surahaaraf #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
